title: Hazy Pinto Empanadas Robata-Grilled
description: A malty, molten, cozy argentinian dish featuring pinto beans, a sweet glaze, and a hint of spice.
instructions: Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch (6 mm).
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
In a small bowl, mix together the pinto beans, chipotle peppers, smoked paprika, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Spoon a tablespoon of the bean mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with water and fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the empanadas to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Transfer the empanadas to the preheated robata grill and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until crispy and caramelized.
In a small saucepan, combine the maple syrup and cornstarch. Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until the glaze thickens.
Brush the glaze over the empanadas and sprinkle with flaky sea salt to taste.
Serve the Hazy Pinto Empanadas Robata-Grilled hot, with additional glaze on the side if desired.
